connector.name: Rubin Exchange
connector.registryDescription: Rubin: self-custody DEX for crypto perpetuals & spot - trade, read positions, orders, balances.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mainnet.rubin.trade over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace trade.rubin, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer MCP token - mint one on the Rubin exchange at rubin.trade (Trading Keys -> MCP Token).
